author: The Infographics Show
description:
Top AI researchers are walking away from some of the most powerful tech companies on Earth, and their reasons are raising serious alarms.

From the invention of the Transformer architecture to the explosive growth of trillion-parameter models, artificial intelligence has advanced faster than anyone expected.
But behind the breakthroughs, insiders are warning about hallucinations, unpredictable behavior, safety concerns, and a global race for Artificial General Intelligence that may be moving too fast to control.

As resignations spread across companies like OpenAI, Google, Meta, and Anthropic, some of the people who built modern AI are speaking out about the risks.

This deep dive explores why AI researchers are quitting, what they’re worried about, and why some experts believe the biggest danger may not be the technology itself, but the race to deploy it.
